title: Engine Diagnostic References — 2.3L EcoBoost (231kW/314PS)
introduction: I use this page as a signpost for engine diagnosis: basic mechanical concerns and driveability concerns lead to different references. Choosing the right doorway comes before reaching for the toolbox. For this engine configuration, the directions below identify where diagnosis continues; the test setup, measurements, result interpretation and repair decisions belong to those references and are not included here.

edits.text:
For basic mechanical concerns, refer to Engine (303-00 Engine System - General Information, Diagnosis and Testing).

For driveability concerns, refer to the Powertrain Control/Emissions Diagnosis (PC/ED) manual.
edits.why: The concern determines which diagnostic information to consult. Selecting a reference starts the investigation; it does not establish the cause or justify replacing a part.
